segments.observed_fact: Static room/person plate is overlaid with instructional text, arrow, and an animated white finger trajectory.
segments.confidence: high for observable overlay motion; unknown authoring tool
segments.uncertainty: Exact path points, easing, and source layer tree are unknown.
segments.forbidden_substitute: global wipe or generating the instructional text inside the person video

segments.observed_fact: Multiple outfit states share one room/platform shell and exchange focal prominence through position, scale, rotation, and occlusion.
segments.candidate_operator: independent cutout targets on a 2.5D carousel
segments.alternative: pose-matched hard cuts hidden by fast subject motion
segments.uncertainty: Cannot determine whether each subject state was filmed, keyed, or generated.
segments.forbidden_substitute: one flattened montage layer or equal prominence for every outfit

segments.observed_fact: Blink boundaries exchange eye/makeup state; geometric sparkles and large foreground props then cross the frame.
segments.candidate_operator: blink-occluded clip swap plus independent sprite/prop layers
segments.uncertainty: Original capture and retouch method are unknown.
segments.forbidden_substitute: full-frame dissolve through the open-eye interval

segments.observed_fact: Dashboard, steering wheel, and rear-view eye crop behave as a shell while exterior storefronts move or change.
segments.candidate_operator: fixed vehicle shell plus translated/cut background plates
segments.uncertainty: Dense registration is still required to distinguish panorama motion from matched cuts.
segments.forbidden_substitute: regenerating the UI/shell on every exterior state

segments.observed_fact: Fork and facial performance carry the action; pixel hearts enter briefly after the reaction.
segments.candidate_operator: single person/fork motion clip plus deterministic heart sprites
segments.alternative: separate fork layer with tracked occlusion matte
segments.uncertainty: Exact fork/hand compositing method is unknown.
segments.forbidden_substitute: AI-generated text or baked-in hearts that cannot be retimed

segments.observed_fact: Camera chrome/lens dial overlays an outdoor subject, followed by full-frame rotation, scale, motion blur, occlusion, and a final close-up.
segments.candidate_operator: deterministic camera UI plus 2D camera transform and foreground wipe
segments.alternative: practical camera spin joined by blur-matched cuts
segments.uncertainty: Cannot prove practical versus synthetic camera motion from sampled frames.
segments.forbidden_substitute: uncontrolled end-to-end AI generation of camera UI and final transition

next_gate: Build a minimal playable probe for 0.000-11.470 seconds and compare synchronized source/probe frames.
